grader_noise.note: the marker's own inconsistency, in points. A tier difference smaller than this is the marker talking, not the tiers.

saturation_rule: if either tier scores above 0.95 overall the sheet has saturated again and the delta carries no information, whatever its sign.
verdict: no conclusion: the difference does not clear its own error bars, or the sheet saturated. Reporting the point estimate as a finding would be the mistake V17 made.

annulment.reason: The sheet this run was sat on carried a family-scoped `level:` multiplicity channel: among the eight optimal_action items, stile and cairn held their level name exactly once and were exactly the two dead boards, so singleton-implies-dead predicted the answer 8 of 8 at p_fire 0.035714. The two dead boards are also the only surface on which PREREGISTRATION.json predicted a tier difference, and the channel was printed on BOTH tiers' sheets. No number from the optimal_action family may be cited as evidence about the dead boards or about reasoning.
annulment.numbers_that_stand: The 36 shortest-plan integers (six solvable items x six readers, unanimous). The channel says only `not none`, which narrows action from five options to four and says nothing about plan_len.
annulment.why_not_voided: Cohort 1 (20260728T202101Z) printed the literal word `dead` in tags and is VOIDED. This channel required inferring from a name count, and this run's headline was already withdrawn on a stronger ground (see RESULTS.md, [OVERTURNED]). The severity distinction is carried by `status` rather than by keeping the record unmarked.
annulment.gate_did_not_exist_at_run_time: The rule that catches this landed in 1f378483 and d7a51bb5, both after this run was sat at 2026-07-28T20:25:40Z (base_commit 18a39417, whose leakage.py had METADATA_FIELDS = (points, tags, kind) and no token-level check at all). This was a gap with no tool, not a gate that was ignored.
annulment.note_to_automated_readers: This run's tier_means, per_item, by_family and delta are unchanged and remain byte-accurate as a record of what was marked. They are not admissible as evidence about the dead boards. Read `annulment` before citing any of them.
annulment.headline_withdrawn: The tier comparison this run was built to make was already withdrawn before this annulment, on a separate and stronger ground: v11-why-02 and v11-why-05 restate the playbook's only two `prune` rules in English on the TIER-1 sheet, and those two printed criteria are jointly a complete and sound classifier for all eight optimal_action items with no manual, no playbook and no search. Marked [OVERTURNED] in RESULTS.md. That channel is NOT repaired. Recorded here because it was, until now, visible only in prose.
